description: This file defines a static helper class 'CacheHelpers' which provides methods to generate cache keys and a default cache duration for cache management in a web application.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static utility class for generating cache keys and defining cache-related constants.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key string for catalog items based on pagination and optional filters for brand and type.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a fixed cache key string for brands.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a fixed cache key string for product types.
